statement: For a reduced irreducible tuple A=(A1,…,An) of finite lattice supports, the monodromy group on the V generic torus solutions is the full symmetric group S_V, where V=MV(A1,…,An). Reduced excludes a common proper sublattice after translations; irreducible excludes k supports in a rank-k sublattice for k<n.

answer.text: Proves full symmetric monodromy for reduced irreducible support tuples.
answer.display: Proves full symmetric monodromy for reduced irreducible support tuples.
